{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Drop QA orders and refunded orders, and convert revenue
sales_clean = sales[~(sales['revenue'] == '999,999.99')]
sales_final = sales_clean[sales_clean['status'] == 'completed']
sales_final['revenue'] = sales_final['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute overall conversion rate and average revenue
overall_conversion = sales_final['converted'].mean()
overall_revenue = sales_final['revenue'].mean()

# Print the overall metrics
print("Overall conversion rate:", overall_conversion)
print("Overall average revenue:", overall_revenue)"}
